Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.physics

Interface Collideable

All Known Implementing Classes:
ConvexPolyhedra, PhysicsBox, PhysicsParticle, PhysicsPlane, PhysicsSphere
public interface Collideable
An interface for physical objects capable of collision

    • collide

      void collide(Collideable c, Vector<Contact> contacts)
      Checks the object for collision against another Collideable. This method will typically just initiate the correct the correct colllision detection method by double dispatch.
      Parameters:
      c - the Collideable to check collision with.
      contacts - a vector in which any contacts found will be stored.

    • getCollisionVelocity

      org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f getCollisionVelocity(org.jogamp.vecmath.Vector3f point)
      Computes the sum of linear and angular velocities at the given point. The point must be inside the object for the result to be meaningful.
      Parameters:
      point - the point at which to sompute the compound velocity.
      Returns:
      the velocity as a vector.
